_comment: Regression fixture (Guardrail 4): two DISTINCT oracle bugs that share a function name and vuln_type but live in DIFFERENT files (the Beanstalk OR-001 vs OR-002 shape). The merge must keep them SEPARATE. Old deduplicate() keyed on (function, vuln_type) ignoring file, so it wrongly collapsed them.

findings.title: LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice inverts lookback: returns spot when TWAP requested
findings.description: Inverted ternary in LibChainlinkOracle returns the instantaneous price when a non-zero lookback (TWAP) is requested.

findings.title: LibUsdOracle.getTokenPrice ignores lookback for WSTETH, returns spot
findings.description: The WSTETH branch in LibUsdOracle hardcodes lookback=0, returning the instantaneous wstETH price regardless of the caller's TWAP request.
